primary.publisher: Converse County GIS map server hosted by Terra GIS (MapServer MAP13; linked as Map Server from the county site)
primary.vintage_statement: WFS feature type ms:precinct_poly exposes geometry only (no attributes, no feature IDs). The WMS GetStyles SLD defines 19 classes on attribute 'precinct' (e.g. 'Lost Springs 1-1' = precinct 1-1) and labels 'split'. Feature precinct codes are inferred by build.py from the county server's own per-feature WMS renders and SLD class colours; they are not a downloaded attribute.

primary.publisher: Big Horn County GIS map server hosted by Terra GIS (MapServer MAP09; linked as GIS/Map Server from the county Elections and GIS pages)
primary.vintage_statement: WFS feature type ms:prct (WMS group 'precinct') exposes geometry only. The WMS GetStyles SLD defines 13 classes on attribute DIST_NUM (01-01 ... 26-01). The map-server viewer config has no precinct source and the download page offers only parcels, address points and roads. Feature precinct codes are inferred by build.py from per-feature WMS renders and SLD class colours; they are not a downloaded attribute. No vintage label.
